fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2025-05-08, the purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road. The time of the incident was given as 08:05 on 2025-05-08. The online submission was made by Durga Raman (9000000103). Vasanth Mani (9000000382) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Gunasekar Anand, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000050, in connection with the events. Sanjay Mani (9000000120), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned a witness statement and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, witness statement, witness, suspect, CCTV, railway station road, morning
